description:
## [1.7.1](https://github.com/callMeBeyonder/morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.1) (2026-11-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **hypertrophy:** match the API subscriptions path and call interface methods ([8ef8401](https://github.com/callMeBeyonder/morphe-patches/commit/8ef8401f1f7ea4159ad5ee65005b7feaa2a7d258))

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro surfaces that are computed on-device (Strength Score, per-muscle volume heatmap, auto-progression and the analytics screens) by reporting an active RevenueCat entitlement to the app's JavaScript layer. Server-delivered coach programs still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Disables the native tamper check that makes a re-signed build fail to decrypt the server configuration on startup.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the sponsor ads (banner and gate screens) and the full-screen ads. The locked channel dialog is kept.

patches.name: Remove bandwidth sharing (CashRaven)
patches.description: Disables the CashRaven P2P bandwidth-sharing SDK: no opt-in, no background sharing service, no restart on boot, and the sharing menu entry is hidden.

patches.name: Remove unnecessary permissions
patches.description: Removes the boot-persistence, advertising-ID, install-referrer and package-query permissions the patched build no longer needs.

patches.name: Bypass Root Detection
patches.description: Removes the root-detection block so the app can be used on rooted devices.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Stops Firebase Analytics and CleverTap reporting, AppsFlyer attribution, and Facebook automatic app events/advertiser-ID collection. CleverTap push/in-app initialisation is disabled; crash reporting and Branch deep links are kept.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and freemium features in the app, including the full macro and micronutrient breakdown for food items and the dashboard freemium card locks, locked-state CTAs (e.g. "Unlock Macros"), and the expired-trial tag chips. Server-delivered content such as diet plans, coaching, and AI features may still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the premium training features by answering the web app's subscription request with an active `training` subscription, and disables the PairIP license check so the re-signed build does not open its paywall. Account data that the server owns is not affected.

patches.name: Unlock Premium (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.

patches.name: Unlock Pro (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all Pro and PowerPack features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a normal sideload will not run.
